answer: Agents lodge their identifiers inside a vault that snaps shut only when pinned to a live ‘anchor’ leaf—each leaf’s micro-scroll pattern decays by 27s until refreshed. Sybils must procure fresh relic leaves, paying 1.1s of leaf-decay delay plus the cost of a new, non-spoofable anchor node, since no bulk farm can print the leaf’s vein lattice before the decay window closes.
